primitives.name: Conditioned Response Generalization
primitives.verbatim_quote: Resistance to extinction as a function of the number of reinforcements.
primitives.latex: P(generalization | training\ intensity) \propto e^{-\alpha \cdot training\ intensity}
primitives.symbol_and_unit_ledger: {'generalization': 'dimensionless probability', 'training_intensity': 'reinforcement frequency per trial', 'α': 'decay rate constant (inverse intensity units)'}
primitives.assumptions: Exponential decay model assumes independent trials, fixed stimulus dimensions, and monotonic forgetting.
primitives.breakdown_regime: Fails when stimulus overlap exceeds critical threshold (α → ∞) or training saturation occurs.

primitives.name: Extinction Resistance Scaling
primitives.verbatim_quote: Behavior potentiality as a joint function of the amount of training and the degree of hunger at the time of extinction.
primitives.symbol_and_unit_ledger: {'R_ext': 'Resistance to extinction (response magnitude)', 'R_0': 'Maximum possible resistance', 'k': 'Extinction rate constant (inverse trials)', 'N': 'Number of reinforcements'}
primitives.assumptions: Sigmoidal scaling assumes diminishing returns per additional reinforcement and memory retention.
primitives.breakdown_regime: Breaks down when N approaches zero (no training) or saturates at large N.

layer2.mapping: Maps to GSE state-transition models where resistance correlates with player fatigue states.
layer2.telemetry: Player performance degradation over consecutive game sequences

primitives.verbatim_quote: The effect of random alternation of reinforcement on the acquisition and extinction of conditioned eyelid reacticns.
primitives.symbol_and_unit_ledger: {'P(success)': 'Probability of successful conditioning', 'ΔR': 'Reinforcement difference between alternating states', 'σ': 'Standard deviation of noise in reinforcement timing'}

primitives.breakdown_regime: Degenerates when ΔR = 0 (no signal) or σ → ∞ (complete chaos).
